tables.name: personal_task_history
tables.owner_query: SELECT h.id AS rid,r.account_id,h.tenant_id FROM personal_task_history h JOIN personal_browser_jobs b ON b.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND b.run_id=h.run_id JOIN chat_runs r ON r.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND r.id=b.run_id AND r.thread_id=b.thread_id
tables.key_transition: Retain recorded state changes with the owning browser job.
tables.verification: Verify each event belongs to one retained browser job and original conversation.
tables.on_failure: Stop extraction and quarantine unresolved task history.
